name: price-ai-workflow-offer
description: Lays out your options when a client asks to buy your AI workflow, producing AI Workflow Handover Options that compare keeping it as a service, a fixed-fee build and handover, a handover with training and support, and declining, with what the client gets and what you keep in each, plus IP and licensing questions for an adviser. Use for "run price-ai-workflow-offer", "client wants to buy our AI workflow", "sell my workflow", "license my process", "handover offer", "client wants to do it in house", "price a workflow build", part of the Pricing Under AI Pressure Pack by 90n.
